entities.summary: Zenzile Miriam Makeba, nicknamed Mama Africa, was a South African singer, songwriter, actress, and civil rights activist. Miriam Makeba was a composers & musicians from Johannesburg (1932-03-04, Johannesburg–2008-11-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
